summary.text: GPT-4o is an OpenAI model released on 13 May 2024 in ChatGPT, including the free tier, and in the API. OpenAI describes it as an omni model trained end to end across text, vision and audio; at launch it offered text and image input with text output, and audio followed later, for example in ChatGPT Advanced Voice from September 2024.

changes.text: OpenAI says it processes audio natively with text and images in one model trained end to end, where the earlier Voice Mode chained three separate models.
In the API it is twice as fast and half the price of GPT-4 Turbo, with five times higher rate limits.
A new tokenizer needs fewer tokens for many non-English languages; OpenAI shows the biggest reductions for Indian languages such as Gujarati, Telugu and Tamil.
Offered in ChatGPT to free-tier users as well as paid plans.

inputModalities.note: Released modalities of the gpt-4o API model. OpenAI describes GPT-4o as an omni model trained end to end that accepts any combination of text, audio, image and video and can output text, audio and image (announcement, system card); audio reached users later through ChatGPT voice and separate audio and realtime API models.

features.note: General availability of fine-tuning for gpt-4o-2024-08-06 from 2024-08-20.

notes: Announced and released on 2024-05-13. Dated API snapshots (2024-05-13, 2024-08-06, 2024-11-20) and the ChatGPT alias chatgpt-4o-latest are aliases, not separate records; OpenAI also shipped several unnamed GPT-4o updates in ChatGPT (help center model release notes). Audio and realtime models built on GPT-4o (gpt-4o-audio-preview, gpt-4o-realtime-preview) are not covered by this record. System card: src.openai.gpt-4o-system-card (2024-08-08).
